releases.notes:
## Hotfix 1.11.1
* Fix Smithing Table crashing the game #307 by @elenawinters in https://github.com/tr7zw/NotEnoughAnimations/pull/309

## What's changed
* Add 1.21.11 Fabric/Neoforge support
* Added option to invert the hold up config, in case you want to hold up everything *except* certain items
* Added support for the new Spears
* Moved the map item list into the config. This only applies the holding animation, it will not magically render non-vanilla maps in the world
* Switched build system from Preprocessor to Stonecutter

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/NotEnoughAnimations/compare/1.10.6...1.11.1
